summary: Remove deleted root-runner paths from CI input declarations and tighten its retired Clippy baseline.

replay.detail: No replay or migration implementation changes.

schema.detail: No stored schema or wire-format changes.

rules.detail: Remove only declarations of paths deleted by root-runner retirement. Commands, trust, sampling, enforcement, and strict input-list and path-existence checks stay unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No runtime compatibility change. The Clippy baseline drops the retired fractal-legacy-runner package and its three warnings; remaining package counts and toolchain are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Source and build reconciliation performs no live service operation.

manual.detail: No additional operator action beyond the root-retirement release note.

recovery.detail: Existing backup, recovery and compatibility procedures remain applicable.
